Hi Sara / GNL procurement team —

Appreciate the clarity. Quick answers and an updated runbook below. We can provide everything you requested: SOC 2 Type II report, a 1-page data-flow summary, and a redline-friendly SOW. Karthik (cc) will own pricing detail and included committed/overage rows.

Redwood invoice/billing runbook (AWS Private Offer):
- Option A (preferred for GNL): Redwood issues consolidated monthly invoice to GNL (vendor invoice) while AWS Private Offer is used as the procurement vehicle. This requires us to configure the Private Offer with "Invoice Agreement" and add GNL as the purchasing entity.
- Option B: Charges flow via AWS to the GNL account and GNL reconciles in-month; billing sits with AWS (this is the default marketplace path).

Recommended path: Option A (consolidated vendor invoice + Net60) — minimizes GNL’s reconciliation overhead. Operational steps:
1) Redwood legal sends SOW (redline-friendly) + pricing worksheet to procurement (2 business days).
2) GNL issues PO referencing the AWS Private Offer (1–2 weeks depending on approvals).
3) Redwood & AWS complete Private Offer acceptance and configure invoice target (1 week).
4) Finance to confirm remittance; Redwood sends first vendor invoice at activation (monthly cycles).

Draft MAP milestones (owners & target dates):
- Eval access provisioned — Owner: Jordan — Target: 2028-07-29
- Security artifacts delivered (SOC2 + data-flow) — Owner: Laura — Target: 2028-07-27
- Pricing worksheet & SOW to procurement — Owner: Karthik — Target: 2028-07-24
- PO issued by GNL — Owner: GNL Procurement — Target: 2028-08-07
- AWS Private Offer acceptance — Owner: AWS / Redwood — Target: 2028-08-14
- Billing activation & first invoice — Owner: Redwood Finance — Target: 2028-08-15

Attachments I’m uploading here: SOW-GNL-AWS-PO.docx (editable), invoice-schedule-template.csv, SOC2-redwood-2028.pdf (secure link available on request).

We can join your 10am PT slot tomorrow. Jordan: do you want me to drive the procurement-facing pack so procurement has one consolidated doc?

Regards,
